slides.title: INT8 Model Quantization Benefits
slides.prompt: What primary benefit does 8-bit integer (INT8) quantization provide for edge AI hardware deployment?
options: Reduces model memory footprint up to 75% and accelerates TPU/NPU inference throughput
Eliminates the need for model training datasets
Guarantees 100% test accuracy across all classes
Converts PyTorch models into pure HTML web pages
slides.correctAnswer: Reduces model memory footprint up to 75% and accelerates TPU/NPU inference throughput

slides.title: Model Pruning Technique
slides.prompt: How does neural network parameter pruning optimize model execution efficiency?
options: By removing near-zero weights and redundant connections, creating sparse tensors for faster computation
By reducing input image spatial resolution by half
By skipping activation functions during forward propagation
By training models with half the number of epoch iterations
slides.correctAnswer: By removing near-zero weights and redundant connections, creating sparse tensors for faster computation

slides.title: ONNX Hardware Execution Providers

slides.title: TensorRT Compiler Acceleration
slides.prompt: Why apply NVIDIA TensorRT optimizations on ONNX models before deployment to edge devices (e.g., Jetson)?
options: It fuses layers, optimizes kernel choices, and optimizes memory allocation for maximum target GPU performance
It automatically generates Python FastAPI web server code around the model
It converts image inputs to text captions automatically
It enables training models without requiring labeled ground truth
slides.correctAnswer: It fuses layers, optimizes kernel choices, and optimizes memory allocation for maximum target GPU performance
